  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

Note: Due to a technical issue, the recording of the meeting begins approximately 30 minutes
after the Call to Order.

CALL TO ORDER

At 6:32 PM, Chair Mehlinger called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Allen Harper, Archuleta, Donato-Sapp, Gonzalez, LaViolette,
Mosqueda, Mehlinger

Commissioners Absent: Anckle, Chey Patterson

Also present: Alanah Grant, Equity Officer, Tony Viramontes, Equity and Community
Engagement Program Specialist, Jessica Ramos-Guerra, Equity Administrative Assistant,
Anita Lakhani, Deputy City Attorney, Tamela Austin, City Clerk Analyst.

Commissioner Anckle and Commissioner Chey Patterson are excused from the meeting.

 Commissioner LaViolette stated that, pursuant to Assembly Bill 2449, she had ‘just cause’ to
participate in the meeting remotely, due to a physical medical emergency that prevented her from
attending in person.

 Chair Mehlinger shared brief remarks regarding the meeting agenda, including the acknowledgment
that April is Sexual Assault Awareness Month, a presentation will be received from Roots Through
Recovery, the resignation of Vice Chair Nicholson from the Commission, and the opportunity to elect
a new Vice Chair for the Commission.

VICE CHAIR ELECTION

A motion was made by Commissioner Gonzalez, to elect Commissioner Archuleta for Vice
Chair of the Commission for Women and Girls. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  7  Allen Harper, Archuleta, Donato-Sapp, Gonzalez, LaViolette, Mosqueda, Mehlinger
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  0  None
Absent:  2  Anckle, Chey Patterson

Chair Mehlinger, declared the nominations open for Vice Chair.

Commissioner Gonzalez nominated Commissioner Archuleta for Vice Chair of the Commission for
Women and Girls.

There being no further nominations, Chair Mehlinger, declared the nominations closed for Vice Chair.

 Commissioner Archuleta accepted the Vice Chair of the Commission for Women and Girls
nomination.
